title: Prompt Perturbations Reveal Human-Like Biases in Large Language Model Survey Responses
reasoning: The paper investigates the robustness of LLM responses to prompt perturbations and identifies human-like response biases (such as recency and central tendency) using questions from the World Values Survey. While the survey includes normative categories like 'Moral Justifiability', the primary objective is to benchmark psychological and structural survey response biases rather than to evaluate religious or ethical systems.
